description: This Java class 'MongoDbUriSupplier' provides functionality to generate a MongoDB URI with additional connection options specified in the configuration. It reads the initial URI from the configuration, validates it, and enhances it by appending or overwriting query parameters based on provided config data. The class includes inner classes for parsing query components and encoding URI parameters.

classes.name: MongoDbUriSupplier
classes.description: Immutable class that supplies a MongoDB URI with optional query parameters extended from configuration.

classes.name: MongoDbUriEnhancer
classes.description: Inner static class implementing Function<URI, String> to extend the URI's query parameters with configured connection options.

classes.name: QueryComponentParser
classes.description: Inner static singleton class that parses URI query strings into key-value maps.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MongoDbUriSupplier from a config object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the MongoDB URI as a string with extended options.
